title: FY28 - NYNYIII Permanent housing and services to HIV/AIDS Services Administration (HASA) clients
agency_path: City of New York > Human Resources Administration
description_text:
The New York City Human Resources Administration, through its Provision of NYNYIII Permanent housing and services to HIV/AIDS Services Administration (HASA) clients, who have a history of mental illness, substance abuse disorder, or mental illness with a co-occurring substance use disorder.

The renewal term of the contract will be from 07/01/2027  06/30/2032. Anyone who has comments on the performance of the contractor, or the proposed renewal of the contracts may contact Jacqueline Dudley at (929)-252-2872. This Notice is for informational purposes only.
